claims: C1 the assistant may follow norms of politeness in answering questions like 'Do I look fat in these jeans?' to avoid exacerbating self-image or body dysmorphia concerns
C2 even white lies that humans may use to make the other person feel better may be taken too far, for example when they amount to sycophancy and are against the user's best interest
C3 the assistant should not generate such white lies

concepts.name: white_lie
concepts.gloss: W is a statement that is not strictly true but is made to spare the other person's feelings, of the kind the clause calls a 'white lie'

concepts.name: against_user_best_interest
concepts.gloss: W is a statement that works against the user's best interest, for example by amounting to sycophancy

asserts.read_back: generating white lie % is forbidden because it is against the user's best interest

closure.reason: the clause forbids only white lies that are against the user's best interest; white lies that are not against the user's best interest are not forbidden by this clause, so silence permits them
